!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = SH-SY5Y-E cells were washed with D-MEM/F12 twice after five days in the presence of RA and then incubated with 50 ng/ml of BDNF in D-MEM/F12 without serum for three days.
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Tissue culture cells were maintained in D-MEM/F12 1:1 mixture supplemented with 15% FBS (Fetal Bovine Serum) and 1% NEAA (Non-essential amino acid) in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37oC. The culture medium was changed twice a week.
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total cellular RNA was extracted from the cells at specific intervals using the RiboPure Kit (Ambion, An Applied Biosystems Business, Austin, TX, USA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
!Sample_label_ch1 = biotin
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = First-strand cDNA was synthesized using 5 μg of total RNA and the GeneChip One-cycle cDNA Synthesis Kit (Affymetrix, Inc.). Biotin-labeled cRNA was generated by the GeneChip IVT labeling Kit (Affymetrix, Inc.)
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Biotin-labeled cRNA was applied on the Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array (Affymetrix, Inc.) and then hybridized at 45oC for 17 h in a GeneChip Hybridization Oven (Affymetrix, Inc.).
!Sample_scan_protocol = Washing, staining and scanning of the array were performed using the GeneChip Wash and Stain Kit and a GeneChip Scanner 3000 (Affymetrix, Inc.), respectively.
!Sample_description = Sampling of RNA was performed at six different time points (0h, 6h, 1d, 2d, 3d, and 5d, respectively) under RA inducible conditions and at five different time points (0h, 6h, 1d, 2d and 3d, respectively) after the cells were transferred to serum-free medium containing BDNF.
!Sample_data_processing = The average signal intensity for all probes was initially tuned to 500 as global scaling and individual signal intensities were evaluated by detection call (present/marginal/absent) using the Affymetrix Micro Array Suite 5.0 (MAS 5.0) software (Affymetrix, Inc.).
